title: Phaung Daw U Pagoda
scope: Standing Phaung Daw U Pagoda at Inle Lake, including the two-storey shrine, red multi-tiered roofs, gold finial and waterside arrival colonnade and steps.
limitations: Horizontal dimensions follow the standing named building, its attached arriving hall and the mapped pedestrian court. Roof-tier heights, decorative carving and exact landing-pavilion cross-sections are approximated from the photographs.

The independent local radar-derived raster contains roof returns over the shrine. A local cutout is bounded by the mapped pedestrian terrace. Canal water level, retaining wall and stairs are estimated from the visible waterfront and native local terrain. The raw terrain and unmasked field are retained.
The surrounding market, ceremonial boats and boathouse, temporary flags and the shrine’s interior statues are outside scope.
